name: Old Dutch Market
description: Old Dutch Market is an archaeological site in the Matara area of Sri Lanka. The site offers insight into the region's historical past for visitors interested in archaeology.

name: Udukawa Doss House (Udukawa Ambalama)
description: Located in Matara, Udukawa Doss House (Udukawa Ambalama) is an archaeological site worth visiting. The site offers insight into the region's historical past for visitors interested in archaeology.

name: MALIGA THANNA
description: Maliga Thanna, located in Matara, is an ancient fortification believed to have been constructed during the reign of King Parakramabahu II of Kotte in the 15th century. It stands as a testament to the strategic importance of the coastal regions in Sri Lanka's history. The ruins offer visitors a glimpse into the military architecture and defensive strategies employed in the past. Visitors can explore the remnants of the walls, bastions, and trenches, which still provide a sense of the formidable defenses once present. The site also has historical significance due to its role in battles against Portuguese invaders. Today, Maliga Thanna serves as a reminder of the island’s rich military history and its resilience against foreign powers. While much of the structure is in ruins, the remains are well-preserved enough to allow for a fascinating tour. The site is particularly interesting for those interested in military history, archaeology, or simply seeking a peaceful walk through history. Climbing to the top of the walls offers stunning views of the surrounding coastline and the sea, adding to the overall experience.
